# Aunt Jamesina

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v3 ch.Relationships P52](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0052)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Aunt Jimsie  <sub>[v3 ch.Friend P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 ch.Relationships P23](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0023), [v3 ch.Relationships P47](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0047), [v3 ch.Speaks P9](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0009), [v3 ch.Charming P1](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0001), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P0](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0000), +2 more</sub>

## Appearance

Aunt Jamesina is a tiny old woman featuring snow-white hair styled in quaint puffs over her ears, pink cheeks, and a small, softly-triangular face with large, soft blue eyes. She is also known to dress in old-fashioned clothes.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P52](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0052), [v3 ch.Relationships P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053)_

## Personality

Aunt Jamesina is a sweet and old-fashioned woman with mirthful eyes, who maintains a proper respect for the clergy. Despite a strong horror of snakes, she travels to India to explore her daughter's mission field, and she entertains a lighthearted wish to get a yellow silk dress when she reaches heaven.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Friend P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 ch.Relationships P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053), [v3 ch.Anne-girl P2](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0002), [v3 ch.Interlude P6](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0006), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P42](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0042), [v4 CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG P16](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0016)_

## History

Aunt Jamesina was named after her father, [James](../character/james-a.md), who drowned at sea shortly before her birth, and she grew up wishing for a yellow silk dress that neither her mother nor her husband permitted her to have. Known for teasing her suitors in her youth, she taught her daughter to cook before college and prayed for her to become a missionary. Later in life, she moved into Patty's Place alongside her cats, [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) and the [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md), to chaperon [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends during their college years. Over the course of their time together, she managed the household, shared her pragmatic yet humorous views on life and love, and offered a grounding presence through the girls' academic studies, social gatherings, and romantic entanglements. At the end of their four years of college, she reflected with the household on the enduring value of common sense and life lessons before the group dissolved Patty's Place upon graduation.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Friend P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 ch.Relationships P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 ch.Relationships P2](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0002), [v3 ch.Relationships P44](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0044), [v3 ch.Relationships P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053), [v3 ch.Relationships P58](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0058), +22 more_

## Quotes

> "Kittens have to be drowned, I admit, or the world would be overrun. But no decent, grown-up cat should be done to death—unless he sucks eggs."
>
> — Aunt Jamesina — [v3 ch.Relationships P69](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0069)

> "Well, I hope so, Anne. I do hope so, because I love her. But I can’t understand her—she beats me. She isn’t like any of the girls I ever knew, or any of the girls I was myself."
>
> — Aunt Jamesina — [v3 ch.Interlude P40](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0040)

> "Yes, in my soul. But I’ll admit my legs aren’t as young as yours. You go and get some fresh air, Anne. You look pale lately."
>
> — Aunt Jamesina — [v3 ch.Charming P4](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0004)

> "Anybody is liable to rheumatism in her legs, Anne. It’s only old people who should have rheumatism in their souls, though. Thank goodness, I never have. When you get rheumatism in your soul you might as well go and pick out your coffin."
>
> — Aunt Jamesina — [v3 ch.Charming P10](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0010)

> "I’ve got them yet. There are three old widowers at home who have been casting sheep’s eyes at me for some time. You children needn’t think you own all the romance in the world."
>
> — Aunt Jamesina — [v3 ch.Opens P23](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0023)

### [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/aunt-jamesina--phil-gordon.md)

Aunt Jamesina and [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) are affectionate housemates who share a home at Patty's Place along with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md). They frequently chat about domestic duties, suitors, and life, with Aunt Jamesina providing a chaperoning presence while maintaining a relaxed attitude toward the young women's independence.

### [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/aunt-jamesina--roy-gardner.md)

Aunt Jamesina considers [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md) to be a friend, liking him very much and holding the opinion that he is the nicest young man she has ever known. [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md) is a frequent visitor to Patty's Place while courting [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), though his romantic pursuits ultimately end when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) refuses his marriage proposal.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Charming P1](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0001), [v3 ch.Charming P27](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0027), [v3 ch.Charming P36](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0036), +13 more_
